precedents.explanation: Framework common example: a pattern of at-fault accidents and tickets over 3 years. DR-040 specifies that pattern as 1 accident plus 2 or more minor convictions.

Approved rule: 1 at-fault accident (5 years), 1 minor conviction (3 years) and 2 non-payment cancellations. DR-040 drops the payment element but requires a second conviction, so the driving-record bar is higher while the payment bar is gone.
Pending Lakefield Mutual rule: 3 or more at-fault accidents in 3 years. Same lookback, different event mix; review together for consistent driving-record thresholds.
Pending Lakeshore Indemnity rule also relies on "industry practice". Both need the same copycat condition.
